string.text: A gun frame (most commonly used when talking about handguns) is the main body or base chassis of the firearm. It serves as the foundation that holds the entire gun together and provides the user with a place to grip the weapon. \n\n

A blueprint for a firearm refers to a technical drawing, engineering schematic, or digital design file that details the precise dimensions, specifications, geometry, and component layout of a firearm.
